customProducts.name: Double Melt Gourmet Smash Cheese Burger
customProducts.tagline: Twin Searing Patties with Melted Aged Cheddar & Secret Burger Sauce
customProducts.shortDescription: Two crispy-edged smashed patties, molten American cheddar, caramelized grilled onions, dill pickles on toasted brioche.
customProducts.fullDescription: Prepared using prime ground meat smashed ultra-thin on a 500°F cast iron flat-top. Double layered with aged cheddar, house secret umami sauce, crisp iceberg lettuce, and sweet caramelised onions inside golden butter-toasted brioche buns.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Best paired with Peri Peri French Fries and a Chilled Belgian Chocolate Shake.
customProducts.storage: Delivered hot in ventilated burger dome box.

customProducts.name: Crispy Korean Nashville Fried Chicken Burger
customProducts.tagline: 24-Hour Buttermilk Marinated Crispy Fried Chicken Fillet
customProducts.shortDescription: Mega-crispy double-dredged chicken thigh fillet tossed in honey paprika glaze with creamy cabbage slaw.
customProducts.fullDescription: Boneless whole chicken thigh soaked in spiced buttermilk for 24 hours, double-coated in seasoned flour and flash-fried to astronomical crunchiness. Drizzled with hot honey glaze and topped with creamy house slaw in toasted sesame bun.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Enjoy hot with garlic mayo dip.
customProducts.storage: Delivered in moisture-controlled crisp packaging.

customProducts.name: Shahi Paneer Makhani Brioche Burger
customProducts.tagline: Thick Grilled Cottage Cheese Patty with Butter Makhani Mayo
customProducts.shortDescription: Tandoori-spiced malai paneer steak, creamy butter makhani reduction, mint coriander relish, and sliced onions.
customProducts.fullDescription: A glorious Indian gourmet fusion! Thick steak of fresh malai paneer marinated in tandoor spices, grilled over high flame and tucked into a soft brioche bun with velvety makhani sauce, pickled laccha onions, and spiced mint mayo.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Serve with salted potato wedges.
customProducts.storage: Delivered fresh. Best consumed warm.

customProducts.name: Smoky Peri-Peri Chicken Kathi Roll Wrap
customProducts.tagline: Flaky Paratha Stuffed with Peri-Peri Chicken & Egg Layer
customProducts.shortDescription: Crisp flaky layered paratha lined with farm egg, loaded with charred peri-peri chicken chunks and zesty mint dip.
customProducts.fullDescription: Inspired by Kolkata's Park Street rolls. A flaky layered paratha cooked on cast-iron tawa with a farm egg layer, packed with juicy tandoori peri-peri chicken cubes, bell peppers, green chillies, and chatpata masala.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Enjoy straight from the foil wrap with extra lime.
customProducts.storage: Delivered piping hot in thermal insulated wrap.

customProducts.name: Double Cheese Burst Margherita Sourdough Pizza
customProducts.tagline: 48-Hour Cold Fermented Crust with Liquid Cheese Core & Mozzarella
customProducts.shortDescription: Stone-baked pizza with molten cheddar cheese crust, Italian San Marzano tomato sauce, and 100% pure Fior di Latte mozzarella.
customProducts.fullDescription: A cheese lover's dream! Stuffed with molten liquid cheese inside the blistered sourdough crust, topped with fragrant Italian tomato puree, fresh sweet basil leaves, virgin olive oil, and golden baked stringy mozzarella.

reviews.comment: The clay handi sealing kept the aroma locked in completely. The meat was melt-in-mouth tender and the saffron grains were heavenly. Unmatched luxury dining at home!

reviews.favoriteDish: Double Melt Gourmet Smash Cheese Burger
reviews.comment: Delivered in an electric thermal pod under 20 minutes! The cheese was molten, the brioche was butter-toasted to perfection, and the meat had insane crust. 10/10!

reviews.title: Sourdough Pizza with Legit Molten Core
reviews.favoriteDish: Double Cheese Burst Margherita Sourdough Pizza
reviews.comment: Real Fior di Latte mozzarella with a sensational cheese burst inside the sourdough crust. Even 20 minutes later the crust was light, airy, and blistered.

reviews.title: 24K Gold Gulab Jamun - Pure Royalty
reviews.comment: The presentation is breathtaking. Each piece is hand-gilded with certified 24K gold leaf and infused with Persian saffron syrup. Best dessert experience in India.
